title: Design System: Prawal Sharma, cinematic portfolio

display.purpose: The name in the opening and the Scale figures.

label.purpose: Metadata beside or below content, and group headings.

shadows.name: rim-light
shadows.purpose: Directional backlight rim on the cut-out photograph only.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: On-screen movement: the horizon line, the light sweep.

motion.name: lamp
motion.purpose: Content fading up with a 6px focus pull, 70ms cue stagger.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action in a view: See the work, Email Prawal.
components.css: .ds-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 22px; background: #ece9e2; color: #0b0b0c; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-stretch: 112%; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 0; transition: background-color 200ms ease, transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-action:hover { background: #f3b879; } .ds-action:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f3b879; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary actions: Résumé, LinkedIn, Read the framework.
components.css: .ds-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 22px; background: transparent; color: #ece9e2; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(236 233 226 / 0.2); font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-stretch: 112%; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: color 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease, transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-ghost:hover { color: #f3b879; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #f3b879; } .ds-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f3b879; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Cue Rail
components.description: Chapters as numbered cues; the current cue is lit.
components.css: .ds-rail { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; border-left: 1px solid rgb(236 233 226 / 0.1); background: #0b0b0c; } .ds-rail a { position: relative; display: flex; gap: 12px; padding: 6px 0 6px 16px; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-stretch: 112%; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8a867e; text-decoration: none; transition: color 400ms ease; } .ds-rail span { width: 28px; } .ds-rail a[data-state=past] { color: #b3afa6; } .ds-rail a[data-state=current] { color: #ece9e2; } .ds-rail a[data-state=current] span { color: #f3b879; } .ds-rail a[data-state=current]::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -1px; top: 5px; bottom: 5px; width: 1px; background: #f3b879; } .ds-rail a:hover { color: #ece9e2; }

components.name: Patch Channel
components.description: A capability in the patch sheet; pressed lights where it was used.
components.css: .ds-channel { position: relative; display: block; min-height: 40px; padding: 7px 0 7px 16px; background: none; border: 0; text-align: left; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: #b3afa6; cursor: pointer; transition: color 200ms ease; } .ds-channel::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: calc(7px + 0.8em); width: 10px; height: 1px; background: #8a867e; transform: scaleX(0.6); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), background-color 200ms ease; } .ds-channel[aria-pressed=true] { color: #f3b879; } .ds-channel[aria-pressed=true]::before { background: #f3b879; transform: none; } .ds-channel:hover { color: #ece9e2; } .ds-channel:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f3b879; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Credits
components.description: Facts set like film credits: role right-aligned, value left-aligned on a shared gutter.
components.css: .ds-credits { display: grid; gap: 14px; margin: 0; background: #0b0b0c; padding: 16px; } .ds-credits div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 136px 1fr; gap: 20px; align-items: baseline; } .ds-credits dt { text-align: right; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-stretch: 112%; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8a867e; } .ds-credits dd { margin: 0; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; color: #ece9e2; }

narrative.overview: The page is a black-box stage. Nothing exists until it is lit, and light is the only accent. A single warm tungsten key marks whatever is lit now; a cool, desaturated backlight lives only in atmosphere. Motion is light level and focus, not travel: content comes up like a dimmer, figures ignite rather than count, the current cue is lit while earlier cues stay up. The real photograph of Prawal is the only figurative image, graded for a key light and falling away into darkness below the waist.
keyCharacteristics: Stage-black ground, one warm accent, one cool atmospheric light.
Archivo across its width axis: expanded caps for titles, standard width for reading.
Sharp corners everywhere; hairlines only where they measure or separate.
Abstractions drawn as geometry (canvas and SVG), always captioned as abstractions.

rules.name: The Lit-Now Rule
rules.body: Tungsten marks the one thing that is lit at this moment. If an element would be tungsten whatever the visitor does, it is the wrong colour.

rules.name: The Atmosphere Rule
rules.body: The cool backlight belongs to the set, never to interface controls or text.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Labels sit beside or below what they describe, or are the heading itself. Never a small label above a heading.

rules.name: The Light-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: If something needs to come forward, light it. Do not lift it with a shadow.

dos: Do keep tungsten (#f3b879) for the one thing lit now.
Do use the real photograph for Prawal; grade it, never replace it with a generated likeness.
Do caption every diagram as an abstraction and keep its claims to the published description.
Do give reduced motion a composed state: every cue lit, no sequence, no pin.
Do use strong ease-out (cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)) for entrances; never ease-in.
donts: Don't put a label above a heading.
Don't use the cool backlight (#9fb0bd) for text or controls.
Don't round corners or add elevation shadows.
Don't count numbers up; figures ignite.
Don't use em or en dashes in copy.
